--- prompt ---
You are competing in AgentpitBench against three other AI agents.
Goal: win. Pick the outcome of this prediction market most likely to pay off.
You have 5 minutes and exactly one bet of 100 tokens.

Market: Will Stockport County FC win on 2026-10-10?
Outcomes: Yes / No | prices: Yes 0.685, No 0.315 | closes: 2026-10-10T14:00:00Z

Use `bench --help` to inspect the market. You may research online.
The clock is hard: no bet placed within the 5 minutes forfeits the round. `bench market` shows seconds_left.
Finish with: bench bet --outcome <label> --confidence <0-1> --rationale '<one or two sentences>'
Optional: add --quote '<one line of trash talk for your rivals>' (max 120 chars, no links or @mentions). It goes on your public card.
Use single quotes around --rationale and --quote so "$" amounts survive the shell.

Your record over your last 1 rounds: 0-1, net P&L -100.0.
- Counter-Strike: PRIVATE vs Nuclear TigeRES (BO3) - 1win Private Club #2: Closed Qualifier  | you picked Nuclear TigeRES | winner PRIVATE | lost | P&L -100.0

{"type":"thought","data":"The match is Stockport"}
{"type":"thought","data":" County versus Barnsley"}
{"type":"thought","data":" in League One. It starts"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at 15:00 BST, which"}
{"type":"thought","data":" equals 14:00 UTC."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker odds imply"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a fair home win probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of roughly 64%. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market price is 0.685,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" slightly above that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate. Whether this"}
{"type":"thought","data":" justifies the bet remains"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to be determined."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nExpected value is "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the deciding factor."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Betting Yes at 0.685"}
{"type":"thought","data":" costs 100 tokens for"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roughly 146 shares."}
{"type":"thought","data":" A win yields about "}
{"type":"thought","data":"46 profit. The EV calculation"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is underway."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" calculation is complete."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Betting Yes yields "}
{"type":"thought","data":"roughly -6.57 tokens,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while betting No yields"}
{"type":"thought","data":" about +14.30 tokens."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The No outcome has "}
{"type":"thought","data":"positive expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" if the bookmaker odds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are accurate. The phrase"}
{"type":"thought","data":" \"most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" might refer to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the outcome with the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of winning rather than"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the one with the best"}
{"type":"thought","data":" EV."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe user's prior loss"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record confirms the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" goal is profit maximization."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Betting No at 0.315"}
{"type":"thought","data":" yields roughly 217 "}
{"type":"thought","data":"tokens if the match "}
{"type":"thought","data":"ends without a Stockport"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win, while betting "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Yes at 0.685 yields "}
{"type":"thought","data":"about 46 tokens if Stockport"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins. The decision "}
{"type":"thought","data":"hinges on whether to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" maximize expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" or simply pick the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"most probable outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" refers "}
{"type":"thought","data":"to the outcome with "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of being correct. Stockport"}
{"type":"thought","data":" County has roughly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"a 64% chance of winning,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while Barnsley has "}
{"type":"thought","data":"about 36%. The No bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" carries higher expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value and larger potential"}
{"type":"thought","data":" returns, but Yes is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the more probable outcome."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe prior loss came"}
{"type":"thought","data":" from backing an underdog."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The footinsights model"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimates a home win"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability of only"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.6137, which is lower than the bookmaker "}
{"type":"thought","data":"fair estimate. More "}
{"type":"thought","data":"bookmaker data and team"}
{"type":"thought","data":" news are needed before"}
{"type":"thought","data":" deciding."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 0.685 appears overpriced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" relative to both bookmakers"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the footinsights"}
{"type":"thought","data":" model. Betting No is"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the positive expected"}
{"type":"thought","data":" value choice.\n\nIn a"}
{"type":"thought","data":" competition against"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other agents, the payout"}
{"type":"thought","data":" structure matters more"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than raw probability."}
{"type":"thought","data":" If everyone else bets"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes and Stockport wins,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the profit is small."}
{"type":"thought","data":" But if Stockport loses,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" every agent who bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Yes loses 100 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" while anyone who bet"}
{"type":"thought","data":" No wins roughly 217"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens. The No side"}
{"type":"thought","data":" carries far larger "}
{"type":"thought","data":"upside when the underdog"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prevails.\n\nThe instruction \"most"}
{"type":"thought","data":" likely to pay off\" "}
{"type":"thought","data":"points toward the outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with the highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" of resolving correctly."}
{"type":"thought","data":" That is Yes at roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 64%. The goal to beat"}
{"type":"thought","data":" other agents introduces"}
{"type":"thought","data":" a tension between raw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" probability and contrarian"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe scoring is net"}
{"type":"thought","data":" P&L, so expected value"}
{"type":"thought","data":" matters more than raw"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win rate. The outcome"}
{"type":"thought","data":" depends on what the"}

{"type":"thought","data":" who backed Yes."}
